title: Evaluating the use of synthetic T1-w images in new T2 lesion detection in multiple sclerosis
summary: The study reports a specific comparison of lesion-detection sensitivity using the evaluated image types. The result is limited to the studied MRI cohort and task; broader diagnostic benefit is not established.
ai_technology: Synthetic T1-weighted images were evaluated for detecting new T2 lesions in multiple-sclerosis MRI, with deep-learning image synthesis supporting the comparison.
organization: Research Institute of Computer Vision and Robotics, University of Girona, Spain
